chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Salih ibn Saeed al-Rashidi, from Yunus, from them (peace be upon him), who said:
He said: The superior act (fadhil) when entering the mosque is that you begin with your right foot when you enter, and with the left when you exit.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended practice for which foot to step with first when entering and leaving a mosque?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the prophetic and Imami etiquette of initiating movement into the mosque with the right foot and exiting with the left, reflecting the broader Islamic principle of honoring the sacred space through bodily orientation. It underscores the continuity of ritual purity and respect in Shia jurisprudence, linking physical actions to spiritual mindfulness as transmitted through the chain of the Imams.
